answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 65690 Country: India Title: Good Islamic baby names Question: My born baby boy25th March timing 1:25pm Friday. Please tell me some good Islamic names. My wife’s name is Summaiya and my name is Imran. Answer ID: 65690 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 837/776/SN=08/1437) You may choose any name among the below mentioned names it shall carry blessings, in-shaAllah: Abdullah, Abdur Rahman, Muhammad, Anas, Huzaifah, Zubair, Salman, Samamah, Zaid, Hassan. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
